prompt:
生成一张高质量、超写实的 AI 女性角色设定参考图，采用专业影视角色设计 Character Reference Sheet 版式。整体为浅米白背景，柔和自然光，干净高级，统一摄影棚质感。

角色为一名成年东亚女性，年龄约 22 至 26 岁。人物气质自然、温柔、清冷中带一点柔美感。要求整张角色卡中的所有人物均为同一个人，严格统一五官、脸型、头身比例、身材比例、肤色、发型、发色和年龄感。

【核心身份锁定】

成年东亚女性，鹅蛋偏小脸，脸部轮廓柔和流畅，下颌线自然纤细。额头比例自然，颧骨轻微，面中柔和。

眉毛为自然平缓眉形，略带细小弧度，眉色深棕灰。

眼睛偏大，杏仁形双眼，轻微卧蚕，深棕色瞳孔，眼尾自然，目光柔和。

鼻梁纤细自然，鼻尖圆润精致，鼻翼较窄。

嘴唇自然饱满，上唇略薄，下唇稍丰满，唇峰柔和，天然粉色唇色。

皮肤白皙通透，象牙白偏中性冷调，保持真实皮肤纹理、毛孔和细小绒毛，不进行塑料感磨皮。

深棕偏黑长发，中长发长度，头发柔软蓬松，带有自然碎发。主要发型为低盘发或松散盘发，鬓角留有自然垂落的细碎发丝。发髻加入少量淡粉色花朵发饰。

身材纤细匀称，肩颈线条柔和，腰部自然纤细，腿部修长，四肢比例协调。身体曲线自然真实，不夸张塑形。

整体人物感觉真实、自然、柔和、年轻，像真实存在的人物摄影档案。

【基础服装】

淡粉色蕾丝修身连衣短裙，柔软蕾丝与薄纱材质，长袖设计，腰部自然收束，裙摆带轻微花瓣式蕾丝边缘。搭配浅粉色高跟鞋。

服装只作为角色卡基础造型，用于展示人物体型和比例。

版面 1｜全身角度

在角色卡上方生成同一人物的五个完整全身视角：

正面

左侧面

背面

左前方约 45 度

右后方约 45 度

人物采用自然站姿，双腿自然伸展，手臂轻松放置。保持所有视角中的身体比例完全一致。

镜头约 70mm 至 85mm 人像镜头效果，避免广角形变。

版面 2｜脸部角度

生成同一人物的五个头肩近景：

正面

45 度侧脸

完整侧脸

微微仰头

微微低头

严格保持鼻型、眼型、唇形、下颌线、耳朵位置和发际线一致。

版面 3｜发型细节

展示三个角度：

正面

侧面

背面

重点记录发际线、头顶蓬松程度、低盘发结构、鬓角碎发、后脑勺发髻结构以及淡粉色花朵发饰位置。

版面 4｜表情参考

使用同一个人物制作五种自然表情：

平静

自然微笑

认真

轻微惊讶

轻微委屈或沉思

所有表情只改变面部肌肉状态，保持人物身份完全一致。

版面 5｜五官特写

分别制作高清局部特写：

双眼

眉毛

鼻子

嘴唇

耳朵

保持真实皮肤细节和自然光影，可清晰观察五官形状和比例。

版面 6｜皮肤与身体细节

展示：

脸颊皮肤纹理

锁骨与肩部

腰腹比例

背部线条

腿部比例

手部与手指

所有细节保持自然人体结构，真实摄影质感。

版面 7｜日常环境适配

最下方增加五张同一角色的小型生活摄影参考：

居家状态

日常休闲穿搭

咖啡店

工作或学习状态

旅行状态

可以改变衣服和场景，但人物的脸、身材、发型核心特征和年龄必须保持稳定。

整体视觉采用超写实人物摄影、真实皮肤质感、自然柔光、85mm 人像镜头、轻微浅景深、高动态范围、细腻发丝、自然人体比例、电影级色彩管理。

角色设定页采用专业 Character Design Sheet 和 Model Sheet 排版方式，浅米白底色，淡粉灰色标题栏，整齐网格布局，所有图片曝光、肤色和色温统一。

整张图片重点强调：

Same Character

Same Face

Same Identity

Same Facial Geometry

Same Body Proportions

Same Skin Tone

Same Hair Structure

Consistent Character Design

Identity Locked

Character Consistency

promptTranslations.en:
Generate a high-quality, ultra-realistic AI female character design reference sheet using a professional cinematic Character Reference Sheet layout. Set against a light off-white/beige background with soft natural light, clean and sophisticated, with a unified studio photography texture.

The character is an adult East Asian female, approximately 22 to 26 years old. Her temperament is natural, gentle, and poised with a delicate softness. All depictions across the character sheet must feature the exact same individual, strictly maintaining unified facial features, face shape, head-to-body ratio, body proportions, skin tone, hairstyle, hair color, and perceived age.

[Core Identity Lock]
Adult East Asian female with a petite oval face, soft and smooth facial contours, and a naturally slender jawline. Natural forehead proportions, subtle cheekbones, and a gentle midface.

Eyebrows are naturally smooth and flat with a slight, subtle curve, colored dark brownish-gray.

Eyes are relatively large, almond-shaped with double eyelids, subtle aegyo sal, dark brown irises, natural outer corners, and a gentle gaze.

Nose has a slender and natural bridge, a delicately rounded tip, and narrow nasal alae.

Lips are naturally full, with a slightly thinner upper lip, a slightly plumper lower lip, a soft Cupid's bow, and a natural pink tint.

Skin is fair and translucent, ivory white with neutral-cool undertones, preserving authentic skin texture, pores, and fine vellus hair without plastic-like airbrushed smoothing.

Dark brown-black medium-long hair that is soft and voluminous with natural wisps. The primary hairstyle is a low bun or a loose updo, with delicate flyaway strands naturally falling at the temples. The bun is accented with a few pale pink floral hair accessories.

Figure is slender and well-proportioned, featuring soft shoulder and neck contours, a naturally slim waist, long legs, and harmoniously balanced limbs. Body curves are natural and authentic, without exaggerated shaping.

Overall character aura feels authentic, natural, gentle, and youthful, resembling an archival photographic record of a real person.

[Base Outfit]
A pale pink lace body-hugging mini dress made of soft lace and sheer tulle, featuring long sleeves, a naturally cinched waist, and a skirt hem with subtle petal-style lace trim. Paired with light pink high heels.

The attire serves solely as the character sheet's baseline styling to display the figure and body proportions.

Panel 1 | Full-Body Angles
Generate five full-length full-body perspectives of the same character across the upper section of the sheet:
- Front view
- Left profile view
- Back view
- Left front ~45-degree angle
- Right rear ~45-degree angle
The character maintains a natural standing pose with legs extended naturally and arms resting comfortably. Ensure body proportions remain completely identical across all perspectives.
Rendered with an approximate 70mm to 85mm portrait lens effect, avoiding wide-angle distortion.

Panel 2 | Facial Angles
Generate five head-and-shoulders close-ups of the same character:
- Front view
- 45-degree three-quarter view
- Full profile view
- Slight upward tilt
- Slight downward tilt
Strictly preserve consistent nose shape, eye shape, lip shape, jawline, ear position, and hairline.

Panel 3 | Hairstyle Details
Showcase three angles:
- Front
- Side
- Back
Focus on capturing the hairline, crown volume, low bun structure, temple flyaways, back-of-head chignon structure, and the placement of the pale pink floral hair accessories.

Panel 4 | Expression Reference
Create five natural expressions using the exact same person:
- Neutral / Calm
- Natural smile
- Serious / Focused
- Slight surprise
- Slight pout or contemplative
All expressions should solely alter facial muscle states, keeping the character's identity completely identical.

Panel 5 | Facial Feature Close-ups
Produce separate high-definition macro close-ups:
- Both eyes
- Eyebrows
- Nose
- Lips
- Ears
Retain authentic skin texture and natural lighting, allowing clear inspection of facial feature geometry and proportions.

Panel 6 | Skin and Body Details
Showcase:
- Cheek skin texture
- Collarbone and shoulders
- Waist and abdominal proportions
- Backline
- Leg proportions
- Hands and fingers
All details preserve natural human anatomy and genuine photographic quality.

Panel 7 | Daily Environment Adaptation
At the very bottom, add five small lifestyle photography reference shots of the same character:
- Relaxed at home
- Casual daily outfit
- In a coffee shop
- Working or studying
- Traveling
Clothing and environments may change, but the character's face, physique, core hairstyle attributes, and age must remain completely consistent.

Overall visual style features ultra-realistic portrait photography, authentic skin texture, soft natural lighting, 85mm portrait lens, subtle shallow depth of field, high dynamic range, delicate individual hair strands, natural human proportions, and cinematic color grading.

The character sheet layout utilizes a professional Character Design Sheet and Model Sheet arrangement, set on a light off-white background with pale pinkish-gray header banners, an organized grid structure, and unified exposure, skin tone, and color temperature across all panels.

The entire sheet strictly emphasizes:
Same Character
Same Face
Same Identity
Same Facial Geometry
Same Body Proportions
Same Skin Tone
Same Hair Structure
Consistent Character Design
Identity Locked
Character Consistency
